subject: ERROR: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable with tags$script

messages.author: 6112b55b87a6b1f7
messages.subject: ERROR: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable with tags$script
parts:
Hello, this seems a lika very trivial problem but when I try to include an external javascript file to my shiny app I get the following error:

ERROR: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

My code below is as following and the js file is in www/js folder

library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
headerPanel("do nothing"),
# Application Title
#headerPanel(title = "Visualize DEMI transcripts", windowTitle = "demiviz"),
sidebarPanel(
tags$head(tags$script(src="www/js/retina.js"))
)

))

When I use pootstrapPage instead with includeScript and then reference the js file, everything works. However I would like to understand why it doesn't work like this.

All the best,
sten

messages.subject: Re: ERROR: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable with tags$script
parts:
Hi,

Look at this example: https://gist.github.com/withr/8799489

In particular :

 - tags$head should be in headerPanel 

 - use tags$script(type="text/javascript", src = "myjsfile.js")  to include a javascript file located in www

messages.subject: Re: ERROR: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable with tags$script
parts:
You have to set a title in the first arguement of headerPanel, for example an empty one :

headerPanel("", tags$head(tags$script(type = 'text/javascript', src = 'js/retina.js')))
